code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            color = grid[sr][sc]
            if color in seen or color == 3:
                continue
            # Find connected components by color.
            stack=[(sr,sc)]; seen.add((sr,sc)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
                for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            r0=min(r for r,c in comp); r1=max(r for r,c in comp)
            c0=min(c for r,c in comp); c1=max(c for r,c in comp)
            if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            if (all(grid[r0][c]==color and grid[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0]==color and grid[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
                for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                        out[r][c]=color+1
    return out
'''
